note: Motley County has no zoning districts layer. Its only ArcGIS service (Motley_County_Web_Map) holds polling places, addresses, county outline and precincts, no zoning. Texas counties do not zone; only cities do. The seat, Matador, lists a Planning & Zoning department but publishes no zoning map, ordinance or GIS service, and no other Motley city was found with zoning data.
